llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V合金在不同平面上的耐腐蚀性能，与用户关注的多孔结构应力屏蔽、疲劳和骨整合方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration; focuses on corrosion anisotropy, not implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM Ti-6Al-4V在不同构建方向的耐腐蚀各向异性
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备不同取向试样，进行电化学腐蚀测试
summary_zh.result: 腐蚀性能随构建平面取向变化，垂直方向耐蚀性更优
summary_zh.validation: 通过电化学阻抗和极化曲线实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the anisotropic corrosion behavior of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy depending on build orientation.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by selective laser melting in different orientations and subjected to electrochemical corrosion testing.
summary_en.result: Corrosion resistance was found to be orientation-dependent, with vertical planes exhibiting superior performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarization tests.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发适用于3D打印的球形钛合金粉末制备方法
summary_zh.method: 采用气相助燃快速制造工艺生产Ti-6Al-4V球形颗粒
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出球形度好、粒径可控的合金粉末
summary_zh.validation: 未提供力学或生物医学验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a rapid manufacturing method for producing spherical Ti-6Al-4V alloy powders suitable for 3D printing.
summary_en.method: A gas-phase supported process was used to synthesize spherical particles with controlled size and morphology.
summary_en.result: Spherical Ti-6Al-4V particles with good flowability and homogeneity were obtained.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation related to biomedical implant performance was conducted.
